label: caiso 7 floor ccct
definition: CAISO keeper, all mechanisms now config-default (bare --iso CAISO run). RA must-offer midday gas floor scoped to gas_cc/gas_ct (frac 0.80) + negative curtailable-renewable offers + 2025 hydro repin. Supersedes caiso-6: excluding the near-retired gas_st boilers from the floor drops phantom steam (ST_GAS 3.66->2.64 TWh, 2024). Mix disciplined vs EIA-923 (2024 gas 71.2 vs 67.7, +5.3%; wind/solar match EIA-930); LMP min collapses 28->0 every year. Mean LMP ~54 vs actual ~33 (beyond-floor level = offer-curve phase); residual ST_GAS/biomass over-run and the 2023 import over-volume are deferred (see DIAGNOSIS-caiso-scoring-2026-06-17.md).
